title: Cleaning Service Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control site preparation, cleaning, disinfection, inspection, and secure handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete cleaning service follow-up visit checklist for rooms, surfaces, fixtures, chemicals, tools, and controlled items. It connects cleaning plan, product label, safety data, and site instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a trained cleaning technician or team lead must compare a current cleaning service condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.guidance: This cleaning service follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when chemical identity, compatibility, dilution, ventilation, exposure, biohazard, sharps, security, or occupied-area control is uncertain. A cleaning, chemical-safety, or site supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
